title: Свеча в гробнице: Бездна Южного моря
alt: Загадочные огни гробницы: Южные руины / Candle in the Tomb: South Sea Tomb 鬼吹灯之南海归墟
description: Hu Bayi and his companions, commissioned by Professor Chen, travel to Coral Temple Island in the South China Sea and hire Ruan Hei and his apprentice to embark on the Trident to search for the Qin Emperor's Bone Mirror. After their adventure, they crash into Guixu, where they discover the ancient mirror within the shipwreck and learn that Ruan Hei is Duoling's enemy. While resting after their escape, a mysterious figure suddenly appears, wielding a club, approaching Uncle Ming, who is on night watch. (Source: Tencent, translated)

en: Gui Chui Deng: Nan Hai Gui Xu

Hu Bayi and his companions, commissioned by Professor Chen, travel to Coral Temple Island in the South China Sea and hire Ruan Hei and his apprentice to embark on the Trident to search for the Qin Emperor's Bone Mirror. After their adventure, they crash into Guixu, where they discover the ancient mirror within the shipwreck and learn that Ruan Hei is Duoling's enemy. While resting after their escape, a mysterious figure suddenly appears, wielding a club, approaching Uncle Ming, who is on night watch. 


(Source: Tencent, translated)
